verdict.tagline: Build, crash, and test your creations in a flexible sandbox.
for_you_if: you enjoy building and destruction sandboxes
you want something that runs smoothly on modest hardware
not_for_you_if: you expect reliable multiplayer server performance
you struggle with complex construction mechanics

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long-term players encounter performance drops and disruptions during multiplayer sessions.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that multiplayer sessions can be disrupted by players spawning lag machines or causing severe performance drops.

citations.review_text: The game's nice, it combines the blocky nature of lego and a sorta accurate world, biggest problem with it is probbaly the playerbase, as if you go to multiplayer. There's alot of RP servers, and also, alot of children, and such, if you go make a server, there's a chance someone might get a lag thing and lag the game out, but, overall, it's good. beside the occasional world clipping if you go too fast into the ground, it has alot of mods, and even more mods in the discord, you can also freely make a multiplayer server with minimal troubles. The community is okay at most, and overall, nice. 7/10

This game is super fun when you have people to play with... its also a good game to play when your bored. Now the game does lack some key aspects that would make the game 100x better such as..
More maps, weapons, new sound effects, clean up some bugs, and have better admin control to your own server. 
Now should you buy it??? If i were you YES I 100% recommend buying this game... yeah the price is a little high for the amount of things you get to do with the game but it is a lot of fun. 
Just one thing thats a HUGE problem.. If your looking to play with other people... have fun because your going to load in and someones going to spawn a lag machine and blow up your PC. Or your going to be playing a server called "Alaska Town Roplay" and your gonna load in and your gonna see 2 people flying 200 millian dollar US fighter jets blowing up random people and then to your left you'll see a guy spawning in the world trade center!! so the multiplayer game play is very difficult and kinda dumb... but otherwise this game is good id rate it a 7/10 has CRAZY potiential
